offering_description.value: The company provides secure facility development and management, community reentry, and electronic monitoring services to government agencies. It delivers rehabilitation in custody and helps people return to the community through post-release support and supervision.

quotes.quote: GEO provides complementary, turnkey solutions for numerous government partners worldwide across a spectrum of diversified correctional and community reentry services. From the development of state-of-the-art facilities and the provision of management services and evidence-based rehabilitation to the post-release reintegration and supervision of individuals in the community, GEO offers fully diversified, cost-effective services that deliver enhanced quality and improved outcomes.

GEO's mission is to develop innovative public-private partnerships with government agencies around the globe that deliver high quality secure facility, community reentry, and electronic monitoring services while providing industry leading rehabilitation and community reintegration programs to the men and women entrusted to our care.
